waivers.justification: Owner decision 2026-10-11 ('waive 2, fix 1'): flat SoC net driven by _111540_/X, no macro load, max_ss 0.3278 pF against the 0.3250 pF limit (+0.86 percent), measured in RUN_2026-10-11_08-39-41 (the first SoC run on the sv2v-rebuilt CPU macro, bead dud4). Waived by driver name because it is under 1 percent over the limit at one corner only. The name is synthesis-generated and the waiver is pinned to RUN_2026-10-11_08-39-41: it goes STALE on any re-run and must then be re-evaluated, not renewed. The ceiling is 0.5 percent above the measured value, so a regression on this net fails.
